title: City of Edmonton demonstration alternative solution for secondary suites in rowhouses (Policy B23-01 support)
code_edition: National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition (printing unstated in the source)

facts.text: The City report says it was prepared as a demonstration alternative solution to NBC(AE) Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) to inform creation of municipal policy; it states use for any other purpose is prohibited.
facts.locator: Alternative Solution for Secondary Suites in Rowhouses, PDF p. 3.

facts.text: The report executive summary states its demonstration compares rowhouses with secondary suites and one-hour party-wall fire separations against the referenced acceptable solution; this is the report’s technical conclusion, not a site-specific permit decision.
facts.locator: Alternative Solution for Secondary Suites in Rowhouses, PDF p. 4.

facts.text: Policy B23-01 states a defined option for row houses constructed per NBC2023(AE) Division B 9.10.15 with more than two adjacent houses with secondary suites: certain party walls on a property line may be a fire separation rated not less than one hour instead of a firewall, subject to the policy text and other NBC(AE) requirements.

The policy asks applicants to show sufficient information on drawings and submit the signed Letter of Construction Intention with the permit application; it says an SCO may refuse to issue a permit incorporating the policy in exceptional circumstances.

The report lists conditions including other applicable secondary-suite requirements, continuous smoke-tight 12.7 mm gypsum-board protection, solid-core self-closing doors in smoke-tight barriers, smoke-alarm requirements, and assumptions about local fire-service response/intervention.
facts.locator: Alternative Solution for Secondary Suites in Rowhouses, PDF p. 16.

limitations: This is a published municipal demonstration report and general policy, not an individual application, issued project variance, or site-specific permit decision.
The report expressly states that it was made to inform municipal policy and that use for any other purpose is prohibited; it must not be reused as a design solution for another building.
The policy states a limited option and reserves exceptional refusal by an SCO; project applicability and all other code requirements are unknown without project documents.
No applicant, owner, address, drawings, or site measurements were invented.
